sights.w: Massillon's 1915 movie palace (Guy Tilden design), saved from demolition by the Massillon Lions Club in 1982 and run by volunteers as a 684-seat performing-arts and classic-film house. Heritage Ohio feature; Cinema Treasures history; Clio entry.

sights.address: Cleveland Ave NW to Market Ave N, 6th St NE to Tuscarawas St, downtown Canton, OH 44702
sights.w: Downtown Canton's arts district — galleries, artist studios, live-music venues and large outdoor sculptures/murals — and home of First Friday, the monthly street party that draws thousands. Ohio Magazine ('Creative Outlet'), Akron Life First Friday guide, Visit Canton.
